provider: user-configured third-party Anthropic-compatible gateway; underlying model identity unverified
configuration: --safe-mode --permission-mode dontAsk; built-in tools retained; no customized system prompt supplied by experiment

measure.unit: Python len(str), Unicode code points, not model tokens
measure.normalization: Remove preceding merged conversation text and only the experiment Additional Instructions block; preserve all template whitespace.

limitations: One manual compaction in a short synthetic conversation, not an automatic-threshold experiment.
Model identifier is a gateway alias, not verified Anthropic Opus/Fable.
Outgoing body also contains environment/system messages from local integration; not a pristine official-request benchmark.
Same system/tools in adjacent requests is evidence of prefix reuse, not proof of an actual cache hit.
Resume question restated the marker; its appearance in the reply cannot prove retention.
Client token/cost accounting is not authoritative gateway billing.
